name: Kirishima Kairi
source:
Due to her upbringing as a ojousama, Kairi speaks with unbridled confidence. She is childhood friends with [url=/c98241]Misaki[/url], who she calls "Maru-chan", and is a huge fan of merry-melody, to the point that she's never missed one of their performances.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
